description: A section's header (DESIGN.md, SectionHeader): a title, an optional count, and a ghost "see all" button at the end (actionLabel, called by onAction); TsuyaSpace.s32 above, TsuyaSpace.s12 below.

params.name: actionLabel
params.description: The ghost button's label at the end, such as "See all"; the button is hidden when this is null.

params.name: onAction
params.description: Called on a press of the ghost button; null disables it.
